description: Call this first. Returns one topic of Jabbertoon's guide as Markdown (under 20,000 characters): start (what it makes and the order of calls), cartoon (the JSON program: cast, scenes, lines, moves), text (the same cartoon as screenplay text), moves, characters, voices, places, errors, limits, build (the 3D builder's steps), export (a build as STL or 3MF to print, glTF, SVG blueprints, Minecraft), world (a world of blocks), walk (a place to walk), game (a game's steps), song (the editor's own file: characters, lines, moves, shots, a song), market, controls (pills, actions). Units everywhere: x and y are shares of the stage (0 to 1, the ground at 0.92), times are seconds. Example: {"topic": "cartoon"}.

topic.description: Leave it out for start, which names the others.

name: get_guide
title: Read Jabbertoon's guide for writing a cartoon
